about: 거래처 없이 판매 저장 (원본 E040206 판매입력 · 재고1.md:55 '거래처 비움'): 거래처를 안 고르고 창고 · 품목 · 수량만 넣어 [저장(F8)] → 막히지 않고 partnerId 없는 판매가 판매조회 목록에 생긴다. 만든 전표는 지움.

shots.name: 재고 3 넣기(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:Promise.all(['/items','/warehouses','/partners'].map((p) => window.__api('GET', p))).then(([it, wh, pa]) => { const i = it.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-PROD'), w = wh.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-WH') ?? wh.body[0], c = pa.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-CUST'); sessionStorage.setItem('s2r', JSON.stringify({ itemId: i.id, whId: w.id, whCode: w.code, partnerId: c.id })); sessionStorage.setItem('s2rWh', w.code); return window.__api('POST', '/stock/transactions', { itemId: i.id, warehouseId: w.id, type: 'INBOUND', quantity: 3, remark: 'QA재고1' }) }).then((r) => r.status === 200)

JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:window.__api('GET', '/sales').then((r) => { const t = new Date(); const d = t.getFullYear() + '-' + String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(t.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const s = r.body.filter((x) => x.partnerId == null && x.saleDate === d && Number(x.supplyAmount) === 1554).sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0]; sessionStorage.setItem('s2rSale', JSON.stringify(s ? { id: s.id, docNo: s.docNo } : null)); return true })

js:(() => { const c = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('s2r')); return window.__api('POST', '/stock/transactions', { itemId: c.itemId, warehouseId: c.whId, type: 'OUTBOUND', quantity: 3, remark: 'QA재고1 되돌림' }).then((r) => r.status === 200) })()
